question: What is Jamaican Kalooki?
answer: Jamaican Kalooki is a Contract Rummy variant from Jamaica: two decks plus jokers, nine deals with changing contracts of sets and runs, and lowest cumulative score wins.

question: What is Kalooki?
answer: Kalooki usually means Jamaican Contract Rummy in this context — nine contract deals, sets and runs, Jamaican scoring. It is not Kalooki 40 or Kalooki 51. See What is Jamaican Kalooki? (/jamaican-kalooki/).

question: How do you play Jamaican Kalooki?
answer: Each deal has a contract. Draw, optionally lay sets and runs to meet the contract, then discard. First to go out ends the round; lowest score after nine deals wins. Full rules: /rules/.

question: Is Jamaican Kalooki the same as Contract Rummy?
answer: Jamaican Kalooki is a member of the Contract Rummy family with Jamaican contracts, calling, and scoring. It is the same family of games, not a totally unrelated title.

question: What makes Jamaican Kalooki different from Kalooki 40/51?
answer: Kalooki 40 and 51 are point-threshold variants common in Israeli/European play. Jamaican Kalooki uses nine contract deals and Jamaican deadwood scoring instead of a 40/51 going-out target.

question: How do you play Super Kalooki?
answer: Download Super Kalooki on iOS. Play solo against AI or host a live table for 4–6 players. Draw, lay your contract, call, and discard — first to go out ends the round. See /play/ and /rules/.

question: How many players does Super Kalooki support?
answer: Super Kalooki supports 4–6 players per game.

question: What game modes are available?
answer: Single Player (against AI bots at Beginner, Intermediate, or Expert level) and Live Online with friends. Voice, video, and custom rules are coming soon for live online games.

question: How many decks of cards are used?
answer: Two decks (104 cards + 4 jokers) at minimum. More decks are added with more players.

question: What are the AI difficulty levels?
answer: Beginner (Lucky Larry), Intermediate (Steady Sandra), and Expert (Sharp Shane).

question: What is a contract in Kalooki?
answer: Each of the nine deals has a specific contract — a combination of threes (sets of same rank) and fours (runs of same suit) you must lay down before going out.

question: What is 'down and out'?
answer: Going out on the same turn you first lay down your cards. Opponents score double card values for that round.

question: Can I call another player's discard?
answer: Yes — if you haven't yet laid down, you can call a discarded card. You get it but must draw one extra penalty card from the stock. Maximum 3 calls per round per player.

question: What is the best strategy?
answer: Track discards, minimise high-value cards early, and use jokers wisely (50-point penalty if caught in hand). See Jamaican Kalooki strategy (/jamaican-kalooki/strategy/).

question: Is Super Kalooki free to play?
answer: Yes — Super Kalooki is free to download on the iOS App Store. Entertainment only — no real money, gambling, or prizes.
